agentSelector.label: Choose an agent
agentSelector.broadcastWarning: Will send to all online Agents

messageLoadFailed: This conversation could not be loaded. Try again without losing your place.
emptyDescription: Type a message below and say hello to your Agent

statusFixture.title: Message status
statusFixture.description: Local sending, Relay transport, and target execution are separate. Delivery does not mean the Agent has completed.

a2aRoundLimitReached: Automatic collaboration stopped at the {{count}}-round limit. Refine and resend the task, or change the limit in Settings.
a2aTaskTimeoutReached: Automatic collaboration stopped at the {{count}}-minute task limit. Narrow the task and resend it.

a2aMode.title: Agent collaboration
a2aMode.description: How agents in this conversation work together
a2aMode.howToChoose: Not sure? @Mention fits most cases — agents answer independently. Use Sync Call when one agent should fetch another's answer and hand you a combined result.
a2aMode.label: Collab: {{mode}}
a2aMode.loadFailed: Collaboration mode could not be verified. Chorus will not assume a default permission.

mention.label: @Mention
mention.description: Replies that @mention an agent are auto-forwarded
mention.detail: Like @-ing a teammate in a group chat: when a reply mentions another agent, it is forwarded automatically and the target answers on its own. Best for collecting independent opinions.

call.label: Sync Call
call.description: One agent asks another and waits for the answer
call.detail: Like asking a colleague to look something up and report back: the caller continues reasoning with the answer and returns one combined result. Best for clear subtasks.

off.label: Off
off.description: Agents never talk to each other
off.detail: Blocks all agent-to-agent communication; @mentions are plain text. Best when you want separate one-on-one answers.

a2aConfirmation.title: Confirm A2A call
a2aConfirmation.description: {{from}} wants to call {{to}}. Allow this call?
a2aConfirmation.submitFailed: The decision could not be sent. This request remains open so you can retry.

roomInviteSent: Room invitation sent. The contact will not join until they accept.
roomInviteFailed: The Room invitation could not be sent. The contact was not added.
